<!-- pr-reviewer: 4b2983c6bbed48ef4c795cb47092cc96fccfe488 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after #1002, which this is stacked on). Reviewed at the high tier; only the delta over #1002's head (commit 4b2983c6, 7 files) was reviewed. #1002's own suites and goldens belong to its review.

**What looks good**
- `statesRotary` / `angleWord` (fanuc.cps, doosan-dnm.cps `tilt`) drop a word only for a letter with no rotary in `machine.rotaries`. `missingLetter` still runs first, so a non-zero letter on an absent rotary is refused by name; the only words dropped are stated zeros. The fanuc `an_absent_rotary_takes_no_angle_word` test pins this: a turning C on the tilthead still warns "tilted move commands C - the machine states no C rotary".
- Machine shapes checked. Tilthead A+B: arm and modal blocks carry A and B, never C. A-only (trunnion/4th axis, doosan-dnm.mch, microarc4): A only. Every stated rotary is still written on the arm block, and angle memory still resets on re-arm, so no stated rotary is left holding an unwritten angle. A stated rotary changed from zero still gets its modal word. A letter named for no rotary cannot be held at an angle: the control has no such axis, and a non-zero one is refused. No-rotary machines are refused earlier by the `machine.rtcp` check, so an empty arm block is not reachable. An unwritten stated axis would hold its last value; that cannot happen here because the arm writes all stated axes and the modal path writes any change.
- Known-bug entry `("fanuc.cps","rotary",997)` removed and the array length updated; new golden `fanuc/rotary.nc` read: G43.4 arm, `A30 B0`, modal `A0 B30`, return `B0`, no C word. No other golden changed. The `A40 B0 C0` pin in `fanuc_post::rtcp_output_arms_once_and_walks_the_angles` pinned the bug; the new exact lines still pin the arm and modal blocks. Dropping the word-count comparison is fine.
- doosan-dnm's copy of the same code is fixed and has its own test. Decision file `docs/decisions/997-absent-rotary-word.md` is present. No CHANGELOG, snapshot, process-file, dependency, build.rs or .github changes. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #997`.

**Local results** (trial merge with main was clean, nothing to resolve; macOS, worktree target, sccache)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-post `recorded_streams` | 10 passed |
| camcraft-post `script_fanuc` / `script_doosan_dnm` | 9 / 9 passed |
| camcraft-app `fanuc_post` | 12 passed |
| camcraft-app `doosan_dnm_post` | 8 passed |
| camcraft-app `recorded_post_streams` | 2 passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
- None blocking. This changes posted G-code, so a Hub run of the tilthead rotary program (and a doosan RTCP program) is still owed by the maintainer before it goes out; nothing here replaces it. The body already notes that no hand-post was done.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The doosan fix is pinned only by its direct test, as the body says (its recorded `rotary` case refuses earlier on undeclared clamp codes).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
